bundle.shortDescription: Inspect, monitor and debug apps in Android emulators and iOS simulators
bundle.longDescription: EmuLabZip is an open-source lab for developers: device info, live logs, performance, memory and storage for Android emulators and iOS simulators, in one fast native app.
